lane: فَاثِجٌ , applied to a she-camel, Pregnant; (As, S, O, K;) and so فَاسِجٌ: (As, S:) or youthful, and having conceived: (As, S:) or having conceived, and become goodly: (AO, S:) or having conceived, and become fat, being youthful: (TA:) pl. فَوَاثِجُ. (S, O.) And, so applied, i. q. حَائِلٌ [i. e. One not conceiving during a year, or two years, or some years], and fat: (O, K:) thus having two contr. significations. (K.) And, (K,) accord. to IDrd, (O,) A she-camel having a large hump, and fat; (O, K;) and so though she be not حَائِل. (O.)

entries.text: الفاثج: الناقة الحامل، والحائل السمينة، ضد، والكوماء السمينة. وفثج: نقص، و الماء الحار بالبارد: كسر حره، وأثقل، كفثج. وأفثج: ترك، وأعيا، وانبهر، كأفثج، بالضم.
